ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Preventive Visit — Madam C. J. Walker

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Madam Walker is a 49-year-old company founder with hypertension and chronic kidney disease G3a A2 who comes for her yearly preventive visit six weeks after her eleven-week review. Amlodipine was added then, and her home readings now average 127/80. She has had no ankle swelling, dizziness or genital itching. She restarted losartan and empagliflozin after the stomach illness two months ago and has had no further trouble. She has been on the road three weeks out of four, sleeping six hours on travel nights. She is using the salt-free seasoning at home and asking for sauces on the side at banquets. She wants to know which screening tests she needs and when, so that she can fit them between trips. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with her consent. She wants full treatment of any illness that could be reversed, including dialysis if her kidneys ever failed, and wants to be told plainly what is happening at every stage. She has named a health care agent, recorded in the confidential part of the chart and not named here, and has a will and business succession plan in place through her company. She chose not to record other treatment preferences today. To be revisited yearly or after any serious illness. [S]
